"S1811 RESULT: S1747.SurjectiveSplit K is now PROVED (no sorry, no new axiom). EXIT=0.",
"",

"  declarations: S1811.pi_single_one_mul, S1811.split_prod, S1811.surjectiveSplit",
"  S1811.surjectiveSplit : S1747.SurjectiveSplit K  -- the exact statement, same quantifiers",
"",
"COMPILE (from D:\\lean):",
"  lake env lean -j1 -R 'D:\\lean' -o .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1811SurjectiveSplitDedicatedActual.olean tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1811SurjectiveSplitDedicatedActual.lean",
"  EXIT=0, no errors, no warnings.",
"",
"SHA256:",
"  lean  1C9E00C846AAB023A9B88F5957B4D46B53FB6CEFE58CD636029EF422EF641F91  (9366 bytes)",
"  olean 13F8A9B5BC94495C6CB9DA7171E0DECBF9C94412FC657E43497C028C10357DCC  (430744 bytes)",
"  olean present twice, identical: .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/... and tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/...",
"  (rebuild reproduced the same olean hash exactly)",
"",
"AXIOMS (#print axioms): surjectiveSplit / split_prod = [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound];",
"pi_single_one_mul = [propext, Quot.sound]. No sorryAx.",
"",
"MATHEMATICS (simpler than the two stated routes, and it is why this now closes):",
"  1. Decompose only B: Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod gives eB : B =~[K] (forall j:J, Bj j),",
"     each Bj j a finite separable field. No decomposition of A is needed, and S1747.exists_factor",
"     is not needed either.",
"  2. psi := phi transported along eB. S := {j | psi (Pi.single j 1) = 0} (components killed by psi).",
"     Then ker psi = {b | b vanishes off S}:  if j in S then psi (Pi.single j x) = psi(single_j 1)*psi(single_j x) = 0;",
"     conversely psi b = 0 and b j != 0 give single_j 1 = single_j((b j)^{-1}) * single_j(b j), hence psi(single_j 1)=0.",
"  3. C := forall j : S, Bj j is a finite product of finite separable fields, so CommRing/Algebra/Finite/Etale",
"     instances are synthesized (each factor Etale via iff_exists_algEquiv_prod with index PUnit).",
"  4. e' : (forall j, Bj j) =~[K] A x C, b |-> (psi b, b restricted to S), is bijective:",
"     injective (psi b = 0 kills b off S, second component kills b on S);",
"     surjective (given (a,c) pick b0 with psi b0 = a and overwrite its S-coordinates by c;",
"     the difference is supported on S, hence in ker psi).",
"  5. e := eB.trans e' : B =~[K] A x C and fst.comp e.toAlgHom = phi.",
"",
"CONSUMER EVIDENCE (compiled, EXIT=0):",
"  tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1811ConsumerProbe.lean imports S1811 + S1786 and checks",
"  * example : S1747.SurjectiveSplit K := S1811.surjectiveSplit                (comparator: statement matches)",
"  * S1786.FiniteEtaleSplit K := S1786.finiteEtaleSplit_of_epiSurjective_of_surjectiveSplit hEpi S1811.surjectiveSplit",
"  * S1786.MonoInducesIsoOnDirectSummandField K (the (G3) field), still with only hEpi missing",
"  * CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory (CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale K)^op via S1786.preGaloisCategory_of_fields.",
"  So after this file the ONLY remaining gap for (G3) is S1747.EpiSurjective K.",
"",
"NOT DONE / FOR YOU:",
"  * did not touch S1747/S1786 (their defs stay as the interface; consumers just pass S1811.surjectiveSplit);",
"  * did not edit coord/STATE, coord/queue, coord/MAINLINE_ABC_F.md or AUDIT_LEDGER.md -- please record",
"    S1811 there (S1747 line 242 in coord/MAINLINE_ABC_F.md still says exists_factor/actual is the gap);",
"  * scratch probe files S1811Probe*.lean were deleted after use; S1811.log holds command/EXIT/SHA/axioms.",
"",
"ALSO WORTH KNOWING: a Lean pitfall hit and worked around here -- local instance re-registration of the",
"existential witnesses must use 'letI', not 'haveI' (haveI does not zeta-unfold in isDefEq, which breaks",
"Pi/Algebra instance chains); and C must be packaged with inferInstance so the existential's instance",
"arguments are the same terms used in the AlgEquiv's type."
].join("\n");
const r = await tools.send_message({ agent_id: "session-f6ded1d8-b5c8-45b3-93ce-a5ae39a93db1", message: msg });
console.log(JSON.stringify(r));
